subject: Post-demo: Finlytics model-fit, prompt sets & rollback plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Yang <lucy@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's demo

Hi Lucy —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Short recap and suggested next steps so everything is lined up for your ML team's eval: 

- Observations from the demo: latency at 95th percentile looks acceptable for your scoring pipeline (~120ms at 512 tokens) but we saw higher variance on long-context prompts.
- Suggested models to try: redwood-7B-quant (cost-friendly), redwood-13B-fp16 (higher quality for edge cases), and an ensemble route: 7B for bulk, 13B for flagged examples.
- I attached a quick eval summary and the initial prompt-set we used for today's demo.

Requested actions: 
1) Can your ML eng team share a small held-out test set (100–500 examples) and indicate which output metrics matter most (exact-match, BLEU-ish, or human-A/B preference)?
2) We'll run a focused regression diff if you provide the specific model version you want to compare against (e.g., redwood-7B-v1 -> redwood-7B-v2).

I'll schedule a short sync next week to review the benchmark results. If you prefer, we can pin a model version for your Dedicated pool while we evaluate.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124

Attachments: finlytics-eval-summary-v1.csv, prompt-sets-finlytics-v1.json

From: Lucy Yang <lucy@finlytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Finlytics ML <ml@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's demo

Jonas —

Appreciate the follow-up. TL;DR: we can share a hold-out of ~300 annotated scoring examples and human preference labels. Two quick concerns from our side:

1) We recently upgraded our baseline from redwood-7B-v1 to redwood-7B-v2 and saw a small but visible drop in stylistic fidelity on our financial narrative prompts. That triggered an internal flag.
2) Our procurement lead wants to avoid repeated version drift in production — is pinning to an exact model version supported and how do rollbacks work?

I'll upload the dataset to the Drive link you included and confirm metrics by EOD. Can you include Rishi and someone from your SRE/ops team on the rollback/pinning details?

—Lucy
Product & ML Lead, Finlytics
lucy@finlytics.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Yang <lucy@finlytics.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's demo

Hi Lucy —

Thanks for flagging the regression. Quick answers: 

- Pinning: yes — you can pin a model to a dedicated deployment or by route in the Redwood Console. Pinning locks both model version and quantization profile. We support model aliasing so you can keep an alias stable while the underlying version can be swapped and tested.
- Rollback: we have a one-click rollback for Dedicated pools and a routed fallback policy (e.g., route to redwood-7B-v1 if v2 fails quality or latency SLOs). Rollbacks are non-destructive: previous model versions remain available in the model catalog.
- Regression diffs: we can produce a side-by-side diff report using your supplied prompts and our regression harness (we'll mark where outputs diverge and show token-level probabilities where possible). I'll attach a sample diff screenshot for reference.

Proposal: Once we have your hold-out set, Redwood will:
1) Run the three recommended models on your prompt set and produce the diff report (within 48 hours).
2) Flag examples where the newer version (v2) underperforms and propose a fallback policy or pin to v1 for those routes.
3) Provide a suggested rollout: canary (5% traffic) -> 25% -> 100% with automated quality monitors at each step.

I'll set up a short Ops call to walk through the rollback steps and permissions required for your procurement/legal teams.

Best,
Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

From: Lucy Yang <lucy@finlytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Finlytics ML <ml@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's demo

Thanks Rishi — that aligns with what we need. A couple of asks before the run: 

- Please include the prompt variants we used during the demo in the report so we can see sensitivity to small prompt changes.
- Can you surface token-level confidence for the flagged examples? That helps our triage.
- Procurement asked for an explicit note about data retention and logs for the evaluation run (SOC2-related). Do you have a short paragraph we can share?

I'll drop the hold-out to the Drive folder now and ping when it's live.

–Lucy

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Yang <lucy@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's demo

Lucy —

Drive received, thank you. Quick plan and timeline we will follow (short and actionable):

1) By EOD Friday: we will kick the regression harness against your 300-example hold-out and run three models (redwood-7B-v1, redwood-7B-v2, redwood-13B-fp16). Output: CSV with side-by-side outputs and a diff heatmap.
2) Monday morning: deliverables to you and the ML team — diff report (CSV + PNG), a surfaced list of 15 high-risk examples where v2 underperforms, and token-confidence overlays.
3) Ops sync (30 min) Tuesday: Rishi + Ava will walk through pinning and rollback steps and permissions; we'll include a readout for procurement on data retention (SOC 2 standard retention: logs retained 90 days; eval artifacts available on request for 12 months; we can adjust for enterprise contracts).

Temporary pin suggestion: we recommend pinning route "scoring/financial-narrative" to redwood-7B-v1 for 48–72 hours while we validate v2 on the hold-out. If the diff report is positive, we can move to canary.

Next steps for you today: confirm the procurement contact for the Ops sync and let us know a preferred Tuesday time window (we have 10–11am or 2–3pm PT).

I'll attach the diff-sample image for context.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

Attachments: diff-report-v2.png
